O.outcome_detail: pooled cognitive performance including fluid intelligence, working memory, and vocabulary

cells.quote: Applying the cingulate-based grouping to independent groups of typically-developing children and struggling learners showed that children with lower cingulum FA showed lower performance across a variety of cognitive performance measures (e.g., fluid intelligence, working memory, and vocabulary) 45.
cells.note: The review reports a clustering study of white-matter microstructure in 313 children and adolescents and does not provide a printed effect size.
